cudgel.name: Leadwood cudgel
cudgel.description: Dazes and breaks a guarded stance.

staff.name: River staff
staff.description: Sweeps space and supports mobile guard.

crossbow.name: Windlass crossbow
crossbow.description: A prepared ranged shot with reload commitment.

longbow.name: Yew longbow
longbow.description: Long prepared fire; weather and movement matter.

sling.name: Shepherd's sling
sling.description: Quick high-arcing cast with loose shot.

heavy crossbow.name: Trestle arbalest
heavy crossbow.description: A severe long lane with setup and slow reload.

pike.name: Boarding pike
pike.description: Brace and control at exceptional reach.

paired knives.name: Paired short knives
paired knives.description: Mobile paired cuts at intimate range.

javelins.name: Bundle of javelins
javelins.description: Finite throws with a remaining close thrust.

war hammer.name: Quarry war hammer
war hammer.description: Break protection and drive a target backward.

weighted net.name: Weighted net and knife
weighted net.description: Restrain at range before closing with a knife.

staff sling.name: Oak staff sling
staff sling.description: Arcs selected stones over low cover but needs casting room.

hooked javelin.name: Hooked river javelin
hooked javelin.description: Pulls a target and leaves a physical recoverable shaft.

boar spear.name: Crossbar boar spear
boar spear.description: Pins a charge at reach; unwieldy when crowded.

handgonne.name: Powder handgonne
handgonne.description: A loud prepared shot that creates powder smoke.

rope.name: Tarred rope
rope.description: Climbing, recovery, restraint, and route control.

quiet shoes.name: Reed-soled shoes
quiet shoes.description: A quiet secondary pair for deliberate crossings.

cargo harness.name: Cargo harness
cargo harness.description: Carries weight securely but occupies pack room.

hooded lantern.name: Hooded lantern
hooded lantern.description: Finite controlled light and animal deterrence.

felt hood.name: Felt hood
felt hood.description: Warm, quiet, and poor against points.

quilted jack.name: Quilted jack
quilted jack.description: Flexible blunt protection that absorbs rain.

reedscale vest.name: Lacquered reedscale vest
reedscale vest.description: Light cut protection that sheds water.

splinted arms.name: Splinted armguards
splinted arms.description: Strong guard support with reduced reach.

mail mitts.name: Mail mitts
mail mitts.description: Excellent cut cover; slow to reload.

tarred gauntlets.name: Tarred hide gauntlets
tarred gauntlets.description: Weatherproof grip around salt and wet rope.

wool chausses.name: Wool chausses
wool chausses.description: Warm, quiet, and liable to hold water.

brigandine cuisses.name: Brigandine cuisses
brigandine cuisses.description: Heavy leg cover that worsens steep footing.

reed shoes.name: Reed shoes
reed shoes.description: Quiet on dry paths, poor on sharp stone.

hobnailed boots.name: Hobnailed boots
hobnailed boots.description: Grip scree and resist sharp ground; noisy on boards.

marsh waders.name: Oiled marsh waders
marsh waders.description: Stay dry in mud and shallows but slip on rock.

reed brim.name: Woven reed brim
reed brim.description: Sheds salt spray; neither warm nor proof against points.

kiln face wrap.name: Kiln face wrap
kiln face wrap.description: Filters smoke; heat-resistant cloth lasts longer in sparks, but offers little impact cover.

ridge visor.name: Slotted ridge visor
ridge visor.description: Turns points and grit; narrow slots cost two paces of sight and ranged reach.

cork-backed coat.name: Cork-backed working coat
cork-backed coat.description: Floats a light or laden bearer through current; bulky and weak against blades.

kiln apron.name: Limewashed kiln apron
kiln apron.description: Absorbs one fire harm while wearing; lime dust is shed, points are not.

winter felt coat.name: Winter felt coat
winter felt coat.description: Warm blunt padding; saturated layers add four weight.

reed splints.name: Bound reed splints
reed splints.description: Light bracing strengthens a dry guard; vulnerable bindings absorb rain.

quarry sleeves.name: Limeworker's sleeves
quarry sleeves.description: Broad lime-dust and thorn cover; heavier than plain linen.

watch vambraces.name: Watch vambraces
watch vambraces.description: Point-facing slats and dry tool grip; poor blunt padding.

potter mitts.name: Padded potter mitts
potter mitts.description: Heat- and lime-resistant palms; add stiffness without providing wet grip.

archer tabs.name: Waxed archer tabs
archer tabs.description: Maintain hand grip when wet; almost no protection against a strike.

split-hide palms.name: Split-hide palms
split-hide palms.description: Salt-resistant wet grip without metal noise; points pass through.

reed gaiters.name: Reed gaiters
reed gaiters.description: Shed spray and thorns; narrow cover only works fully behind guard.

quarry chaps.name: Quarry chaps
quarry chaps.description: Lime-resistant broad work cover; stiff on slopes.

frost leggings.name: Frost-felt leggings
frost leggings.description: Warm broad padding for long watches; takes water weight.

peat pattens.name: Peat-board pattens
peat pattens.description: Spread load over mud without bogging; leave sharp stone unprotected.

felt overboots.name: Felt overboots
felt overboots.description: Warm quiet soles; wet felt gains weight and lacks scree grip.

ice cleats.name: Linked ice cleats
ice cleats.description: Grip scree and frozen shallows; links ring on dry deck boards.

field flask.name: Field flask
field flask.description: A reusable four-measure physical vessel for freeform reagents.

skill journal.name: Skill journal
skill journal.description: A physical written lesson that another courier may study at the common deck.

component:iron billet.name: Iron billet
component:iron billet.description: A finite smelted stock for accountable fabrication.

pot sling.name: Cooper's pot sling
pot sling.description: P selects a finite pitch, lime or brine pot; Enter casts at a visible cell three to six paces away. The shared reaction can harm anyone.

throwing axe.name: Balanced throwing axe
throwing axe.description: Throws the actual readied axe onto the impact cell, leaving an empty weapon slot. It weakens timber support and must be physically recovered.

forked pike.name: Forked ward pike
forked pike.description: Pins the target and one neighbour across its forward line, buying one turn against a pair. Adjacent foes are inside the forks.

war flail.name: Jointed threshing flail
war flail.description: One exposed wind-up precedes a sweep through nearby foes. Moving abandons the wind-up; the wide head also harms a nearby convoy escort.

spade.name: Bank cutter's spade
spade.description: Cuts reeds and digs banks with F. A strike from dry soil or ash throws sight-obscuring dust; wet or stone footing gives no dust.

shield and hanger.name: Boarding shield and hanger
shield and hanger.description: A clear, dry, same-level approach closes up to two paces under guard before a short cut. An encumbered load or injured leg cannot charge.

glaive.name: Coppice glaive
glaive.description: Keeps a two-pace minimum and clips one body beside the target. Close inside the blade or separate the line.

pollaxe.name: Quarry pollaxe
pollaxe.description: The hammer and beak punish protectors, elites and machinery, and the back spike damages timber support.

arming sword.name: Watch arming sword
arming sword.description: A measured cut leaves a guarded counter-posture while reducing the target's willingness to press.

long knife.name: Smokehouse long knife
long knife.description: A silent close cut interrupts a marked ranged aim. Its small edge is poor for force or reach.

boat hook.name: Long-shafted boat hook
boat hook.description: Pulls a body one pace, or two from flooded ground, turning channels into a rescue or separation tool.

flanged mace.name: Gatewatch flanged mace
flanged mace.description: A compact impact breaks three morale; distance and disciplined protection answer it.

estoc.name: Needle estoc
estoc.description: A narrow thrust gains two harm against protectors, elites and machinery but has no crowd control.

felling axe.name: Charcoal felling axe
felling axe.description: A loud close cut removes two support from timber on the impact cell, opening routes or risking collapse.

quarterstaff.name: Ferruled quarterstaff
quarterstaff.description: Drives a target back and leaves a guarded stance, trading harm for space and safety.

reed sickle.name: Fen reed sickle
reed sickle.description: Cuts reeds beneath a target into loose dry fuel and shakes animals; fire can exploit what remains.

anchor fluke.name: Shingle anchor fluke
anchor fluke.description: Pulls a target while flooded footing anchors the courier in guard. Weight and noise are its costs.

chain hook.name: Cut-chain hook
chain hook.description: Entangles at reach for no direct harm; the target spends its next action cutting free.

iron heel.name: Iron heel
iron heel.effect: Allows F brace, lever and break with the readied shaft; successful work wears the heel.
iron heel.drawback: Heavy; levering makes two extra noise.

quiet binding.name: Quiet binding
quiet binding.effect: Cuts committed attack sound by two; each attack wears its felt.
quiet binding.drawback: Cannot share the structural socket with a heel or retrieval cord.

retrieval cord.name: Retrieval cord
retrieval cord.effect: Leaves a spent shaft or net as a physical recoverable item; nearby casts reel back if the pack fits.
retrieval cord.drawback: Casting range falls by two; ten committed throws wear out the cord.

resin seal.name: Resin seal
resin seal.effect: A sealed string keeps its prepared shot in rain; wet shots wear the treatment.
resin seal.drawback: Stiff string costs one range; resin accelerates fire damage to the weapon.

ash wrap.name: Ash wrap
ash wrap.effect: A shot made from smoke retains range despite smoke inhalation; firing from smoke wears the wrap.
ash wrap.drawback: Only the inhalation penalty is relieved: thick smoke still blocks line of fire.

wool lining.name: Wool lining
wool lining.drawback: Absorbent wool adds four wet weight as well as its dry weight.

reed lining.name: Reed lining
reed lining.effect: Sheds bog mud and gives a usable stance in deep current.
reed lining.drawback: The bulky liner opens a pierce-protection gap at the fitted location.

iron scales.name: Iron scales
iron scales.effect: Adds local pierce protection and closes a coverage gap.
iron scales.drawback: One extra noise and mobility burden; no second lining fits.
